title: AgentOfficeSuite (AOSE) — Collaborative Office Suite for Humans and AI Agents
summary: A local-first office suite designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents across documents, databases, slides, and flowcharts. It allows agents to interact directly with live objects instead of static chat messages, featuring a comprehensive agent-traceable version history.
research_notes: Uses Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose tools to agents; deployment is managed via the 'aose-main' npm package.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from a research prototype to a production-ready local service with MCP integration. It now supports major agent platforms like Claude Code and Gemini CLI, offering deep traceability for agent-made edits.
